parameters.query: SELECT e.id AS eid, e.status AS estatus, e.reject_reason, e.paid_players, e.amount, t.id AS tid, t.code AS tcode, t.name AS tname, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%e %b') AS day, (t.start_date <= CURDATE()) AS started, t.organizer_user_id, (SELECT l.slug FROM tournament_web_links l WHERE l.tournament_id = t.id LIMIT 1) AS slug, (SELECT l.fee_per_player FROM tournament_web_links l WHERE l.tournament_id = t.id LIMIT 1) AS fee_per_player, tm.id AS team_id, tm.code AS team_code, tm.name AS team_name, u.phone AS coach_phone, d.name AS dname, d.min_age, d.max_age, d.squad_min, d.squad_max, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id) AS squad_count, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', x.id, 'name', COALESCE(au.name, x.guest_name), 'birthdate', DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(au.birthdate, x.guest_birthdate), '%Y-%m-%d'), 'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, COALESCE(au.birthdate, x.guest_birthdate), t.start_date), 'gender', COALESCE(au.gender, x.guest_gender), 'jersey_number', COALESCE(x.jersey_number, au.jersey_number), 'parent_phone', x.parent_phone, 'photo_key', COALESCE(x.guest_photo_key, au.photo_key), 'status', x.status, 'in_squad', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.team_member_id = x.id), 'joined', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(x.joined_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%e %b, %l:%i %p'))) FROM team_members x LEFT JOIN app_users au ON au.id = x.user_id WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING') AND x.role <> 'COACH') AS members, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('players', pp.players, 'amount', pp.amount, 'utr', pp.utr, 'at', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(pp.created_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%e %b, %l:%i %p'))) FROM entry_payments pp WHERE pp.entry_id = e.id) AS payments, g.id AS tgt_id, g.status AS tgt_status, g.role AS tgt_role, g.user_id AS tgt_user, COALESCE(g.guest_name, '') AS tgt_name, g.jersey_number AS tgt_jersey, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, g.guest_birthdate, t.start_date) AS tgt_age, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.team_member_id = g.id) AS tgt_in_squad FROM tournament_entries e JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = e.tournament_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id JOIN app_users u ON u.id = tm.captain_user_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id LEFT JOIN team_members g ON g.id = $2 AND g.team_id = tm.id JOIN app_users ru ON ru.id = e.registered_by WHERE e.id = $1 AND ru.phone = $3 LIMIT 1
